updates.title: Microsoft Purview DLP: Network Layer Protection via Entra GSA Integration
updates.summary: Microsoft Purview Data Loss Prevention now integrates with Entra Global Secure Access to intercept and inspect sensitive data and AI interactions at the network layer, enabling enforcement of DLP policies across browsers, apps, APIs, and generative AI platforms. This extends data protection beyond traditional endpoints to catch risky activity before sensitive information reaches untrusted cloud services.

updates.title: Microsoft Entra ID: Passkey Support for B2B Users
updates.summary: B2B users, including external guests and internal guest accounts, can now register and use passkeys issued by resource tenants to satisfy multifactor authentication requirements, expanding passwordless sign-in capability beyond member users. This streamlines authentication for federated access scenarios while maintaining security posture.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Admin Role Assignment Time Limits
updates.summary: Purview now allows admins to set expiration dates (in days) when assigning users and security groups to role groups, enabling time-bound temporary admin access without manual revocation. This addresses the just-in-time access pattern for compliance and security best practices.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: View-Only Role Management Role
updates.summary: A new view-only role management role is now available in Purview and Defender, granting auditing permissions to see all role group member assignments across both portals without modification rights. This is being added to Global Reader and Security Reader, improving audit and compliance visibility.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview Endpoint DLP: FTP and SFTP Protection
updates.summary: Endpoint DLP now monitors and protects sensitive data transferred via FTP and SFTP from managed devices, closing a gap in data exfiltration visibility for file transfer protocols. Admins can now enforce consistent data protection across legacy and modern file transfer methods.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview DLP: Sensitive Information Classifier Testing
updates.summary: A new testing feature on the Classification page allows admins to validate files against single or multiple sensitive information classifiers to identify content and troubleshoot classification gaps. This improves DLP policy tuning and reduces misconfiguration.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview Information Protection: SharePoint Default Library Labels
updates.summary: SharePoint files can now be automatically labeled to match the default sensitivity label configured on their document library, closing labeling gaps for data at rest without relying on manual user action. This enforces secure-by-default classification and reduces the risk of unprotected sensitive content.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview Data Lifecycle Management: Departed User Cleanup
updates.summary: Admins can now bulk delete both content and containers (OneDrives and mailboxes) for departed employees automatically, removing manual cleanup efforts while maintaining regulatory compliance. This addresses data retention and offboarding at scale.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview Compliance: Cloud Attachments Preservation for Users on Hold
updates.summary: File versions shared as cloud attachments are now preserved for users placed on infinite hold across OneDrive and SharePoint sites, extending legal hold compliance to modern file-sharing patterns. This ensures e-discovery and litigation readiness for cloud-native content.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview Information Barriers: Compliance Report
updates.summary: A new Information Barriers policy compliance report identifies SharePoint sites, OneDrive accounts, and SharePoint Embedded containers that no longer comply after policy changes, streamlining audit and remediation workflows. This improves visibility into information barrier violations at scale.

updates.title: CVE-2026-96940: Microsoft Exchange Server Elevation of Privilege
updates.summary: A weak authorization vulnerability in Microsoft Exchange Server allows authenticated attackers to escalate privileges over the network, potentially compromising mailbox access and organizational security. Immediate patching is recommended for all Exchange Server deployments.
